name: Yamada Saburo
source: The third son of the Yamada family, a junior high school student with the IQ of a genius. Cocky and condescending, but he is honest with those he respects. He’s the brains behind Odd-Jobs Yamada. He respects Ichiro, competing with his second brother, Jiro, for the position of Ichiro’s right-hand man. [Spoiler]With the arrival of his real father, Rei, it triggered a rethinking of his way of being. After much worry, he decided to find his own path, demonstrating his determination in the 2nd Division Rap Battle.[/spoiler]
